# Reliant AI

> Reliant AI is Houston, Texas' custom web design agency for small businesses. We hand-code React and TypeScript websites — no WordPress or Wix templates — for metal fabrication, oilfield services, home services, and medical/healthcare practices. 150+ projects delivered, 98% client satisfaction, 90+ PageSpeed scores.

- Differentiator: 100% hand-coded, conversion-focused, 2–3x faster than template sites

## Services & pricing

- Starter Website — $2,500: 5-page custom site, mobile-responsive, basic SEO.
- Professional Website — $5,500: 10-page site with GSAP animations, CMS, advanced SEO.
- Enterprise Website — $12,000+: Unlimited pages, Three.js 3D elements, custom functionality.
- Maintenance — from $199/month: security updates, backups, content changes, SEO monitoring.

## Industries served

- Metal Fabrication: equipment galleries, capability showcases, quote request systems.
- Oilfield Services: safety certification displays, fleet management, compliance docs.
- Home Services (HVAC, plumbing, electrical): online booking, service-area maps, reviews.
- Medical / Healthcare: HIPAA-compliant patient portals, online forms, appointment scheduling.
